name: TDTowerPlacer
src_typeComment: Runtime tower placement: click a point in the scene (raycast against placementMask) to place the currently-selected tower prefab there, spending currency via TDGameManager's wallet. Wire a shop UI button's OnClick to SelectTowerToPlace(prefab, cost) to choose what the next click places.

src_serialized.name: placementMask
src_serialized.tooltip: Layers a click can land on to place a tower (e.g. the ground, not the enemy path or UI).

src_serialized.name: raycastCamera
src_serialized.tooltip: Camera used to raycast the mouse position. Defaults to Camera.main if left empty.

src_members.sig: public void SelectTowerToPlace(GameObject towerPrefab, int cost)
src_members.name: SelectTowerToPlace
